# 2025_Q148

## Question

3-year-old with generalised convulsions and high-grade fever. First-line drug?

## Options

- A) Diazepam ✅
- B) Valproate
- C) Fosphenytoin
- D) Amoxicillin

## Your Answer

B) Valproate

## Correct Answer

A) Diazepam

## Key Fact (generated by LLM)

Diazepam is the first-line treatment for a 3-year-old with generalized convulsions and high-grade fever due to its rapid onset of action and efficacy in terminating seizures. It works by enhancing the effect of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the brain, which helps to calm down the excessive neuronal activity. Diazepam is typically administered intravenously or rectally in this scenario.

## Why You Got It Wrong (generated by LLM)

The student's answer, Valproate, is incorrect because while it is an antiepileptic medication, it is not typically used as the first-line treatment for acute seizures in children.
